footnote_text: Time Based Vesting - Represents shares of restricted common stock granted to the reporting person under the Issuer's 2024 Equity Incentive Plan. The restricted shares shall become vested and nonforfeitable, subject to the reporting person's continued service as an employee of the Issuer, on November 1, 2027 (25% of the shares granted), November 1, 2028 (25% of the shares granted) and November 1, 2029 (the remaining 50% of the shares granted).

These shares are restricted stock units ("RSUs"). The RSUs vest on the date of the next FedEx Corporation annual meeting of stockholders and shall accrue dividend equivalents when a dividend is paid on shares of FedEx common stock, as set forth in the form of Restricted Stock Unit Agreement for Non-Management Directors. || Ownership has been adjusted to reflect 7 shares that were acquired via dividend reinvestment as a result of dividends paid to all stockholders.
This common stock was issued in lieu of annual retainer fees of $81,200 (rounded down to the nearest whole share).
